mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 indicates strong economic activity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 110.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts decline below 1200.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 113.0 signals deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and INDPRO < 113.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
